```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(survey)
```

```{r}
cholesterol_mortality <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-11-17/cholesterol_mortality.csv')
#handle lonely psus when subsetting
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")
#scale 2yr weight across all 10 pooled cycles (do not use if analysing 1 cycle at a time)
cholesterol_mortality <- cholesterol_mortality %>% 
  mutate(weight_10cycle = survey_weight/10)

```
Survey design
```{r}
chol_design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~psu,
  strata = ~strata,
  weights = ~weight_10cycle,
  nest = TRUE,
  data = cholesterol_mortality
)
```
Example: survey-weighted mean total cholesterol and mortality rate
```{r}
svymean(~total_chol + died, design = chol_design, na.rm = TRUE)
```
Subpopulation analysis
```{r}
older <- subset(chol_design, age >= 65)
svymean(~total_chol, design = older, na.rm = TRUE)
#195.4
younger <- subset(chol_design, age < 65)
svymean(~total_chol, design = younger, na.rm = TRUE)
#195.2
```

```{r}
#look at it by age groups
chol_design <- update(
  chol_design,
  age_group = cut(
    age,
    breaks = c(17, 39, 59, Inf),
    labels = c("18-39", "40-59", "60+")
  )
)
svyby(~total_chol, ~age_group, design = chol_design, svymean, na.rm = TRUE)
```
